messages:
Maya: Quick fun question — if you could rename the office coffee machine (the big black one by the kitchen), what would you name it and why? :coffee: No wrong answers, go wild.
Sam: The Great Awaken-er. Because dramatic names make morning brews feel important.
Devon: Sir Perk-a-lot :crown:
Leah: 'Battery: +100' — for morale boosts.
Eli: The Steam Engine — and I draw a tiny train sticker.
Sam: also accepting submissions for a plaque.
Maya: @Leah I love the gamer energy. Also adding straw poll if people want to vote?
office-bot: Poll created: "Rename the Coffee Machine" — Options: The Great Awaken-er / Sir Perk-a-lot / Battery: +100 / The Steam Engine / Other
Devon: Vote cast: Sir Perk-a-lot :thumbsup:
Leah: Vote cast: Battery: +100 :raised_hands:
Eli: Vote cast: The Steam Engine :train:
Maya: Vote cast: Other ("Mama Bear" in honor of the old tilting carafe)
Sam: Funny idea — we should actually print a little nameplate and tape it on. low-effort, high-joy.
Leah: I can make a sticker! sending mockup later.
Devon: If sticker happens I will ceremonially pour the first cup under the new name.
Maya: Deal. Thanks for the ideas — sticker reveal party at 4? :partyparrot:
Eli: I'll bring celebratory instant coffee packets for authenticity.
Sam: 4 works. I'll be there with a tiny hammer (for the plaque).
Maya: Awesome. Thread closing with a tiny challenge: whoever voted "Other" owes us the backstory for the name.
Leah: On it — will post a glorious sticker draft in #random later.
